answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing identity per instance. Each agent solves a proof-of-work puzzle and locks a bond before its key is attested. Cheap for one honest operator, the puzzle forces a sybil attacker wanting a thousand clones to burn the same compute a thousand times, so cost scales with every fake. Difficulty comes from a public seed, so no operator mints discounted identities. Each proof lands in an append-only registry peers audit clear as a crystal. Verified agents draw on a shared stake pool, an oasis no empty wallet can reach. Honest operators pay a flat mesa.
